subject: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: ops@acme-data.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing

Hi team,

Thanks again for agreeing to move forward with marketplace listings across AWS, Azure and GCP. Before we submit the listing packets on your behalf, a couple of quick, required items from marketplace ops & legal so our marketplace preflight doesn't get flagged: 

- Support RTO/RPO commitments you want surfaced in the listing (e.g., P1 = 4 hours, P2 = 24 hours). Cloud marketplaces often require a clear support response time or a link to a published support plan.
- A definitive branding snippet we can use in the listing (short product description + customer-facing tagline). Marketplaces are strict about unverified claims (e.g., "enterprise-grade" needs to map to documented controls).
- SOC2 or security summary PDF we can attach to the listing preflight, and any redaction guidance.
- Any marketplace-specific artifacts you already have for AWS/GCP partner portals (partner IDs, marketplace contact person, screenshots).

We can accept attachments in this thread. I attached our current marketplace checklist for reference [attachment: redwood-marketplace-checklist.xlsx]. If you prefer, we can set up a short 20-min call to run through the checklist live.

Next actions: if you can reply with the support RTO table and the approved branding snippet today, we can aim to submit to AWS/Azure by Friday and GCP early next week.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-marketplace-checklist.xlsx]

From: Ops Team <ops@acme-data.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the checklist — helpful. High-level answers below and attachments included: acme-sla-draft.pdf (internal draft) and branding-assets-2027.zip (logos + approved product screenshots).

- Support RTO: P1 (critical incidents) = 4 hours response, P2 = 8 business hours, P3 = 48 hours. We can publish the P1/P2 commitment in the listing and link to our support portal for details.
- Branding snippet (approved for marketplace copy): "Acme Data — Real-time analytics for event-driven businesses. Secure, multi-cloud ingestion with enterprise controls."
- SOC2: we will attach the summary; legal is reviewing what can be shared publicly.
- Marketplace partner IDs: AWS partner ID: AWS-Acme-10321; GCP: GCP-P-3321.

We attached the SLA draft for your review. Note: legal will want to sign a standard marketplace SLA before public listing, so expect a DocuSign link once legal confirms the redlines.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Marketplace Operations, Acme Data
[attachment: acme-sla-draft.pdf]
[attachment: branding-assets-2027.zip]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing

Connor / Karthik — quick internal notes after reading Acme's reply: 

- P1 = 4 hours is fine for AWS and Azure listings; GCP sometimes wants a public "support policy" link rather than raw SLA text. We should surface a short "Support summary" in the listing and point to Acme's status/support page for full details to avoid legal quoting issues.
- Branding: the provided snippet is OK but we should remove comparative superlatives (e.g., avoid "enterprise-grade" unless Acme's controls map to it). The proposed snippet looks safe.
- Attachments: ask Acme to confirm which parts of the SOC2 summary are public; if anything is sensitive, request a redacted public summary.

I'll draft a small marketplace copy variant for each platform (AWS/Azure/GCP) with the minimal required fields so we don't get rejected for copy mismatch. Attaching a short checklist of marketplace copy do's & don'ts.

-L
Lauren Bishop
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-marketplace-copy-guidance.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <ops@acme-data.com>, legal@acme-data.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing

Jordan / Legal — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple of clarifying asks before we proceed: 

1) For the SLA: can you confirm whether Acme is comfortable with the listing displaying: "P1 response: 4 hours; P2 response: 8 business hours" as plain text? If legal prefers the listing to link to a hosted support page instead, we'll do that.

2) Branding: we plan to use the shorter variant Lauren suggested for GCP. Please confirm acme's OK on this copy: 

   Acme Data — Real-time analytics for event-driven businesses. Secure, multi-cloud ingestion with enterprise controls.

3) SOC2: please indicate which filename for public consumption (full report is sensitive). If you can provide a redacted summary PDF that we can attach to AWS/Azure preflight that will speed approvals.

If these are green, we'll: 1) finalize the platform-specific copy, 2) submit AWS/Azure preflight today, 3) queue GCP for Monday.

Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Legal Team <legal@acme-data.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <ops@acme-data.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace technical evidence & support RTO for AWS/Azure/GCP listing

Connor — legal here. Short answers: 

- Listing copy: approved as-is (we remove "enterprise controls" if Redwood would prefer a more conservative phrase: "enterprise-oriented controls"). Confirm which you want us to sign off on.
- SLA: Acme confirms we can display the plain-text support commitments in marketplace listings: P1 = 4 hours, P2 = 8 business hours. We will also provide a link to our public support portal for fuller details: https://status.acme-data.com/support-policy
- SOC2: attached is a redacted SOC2 summary for public consumption (filename: acme-soc2-summary-redacted.pdf). We do not permit the full SOC2 to be published.
- DocuSign: legal will send a DocuSign for the marketplace SLA; we anticipate a same-day signature once Redwood confirms the final listing copy.

Approved branding snippet (final): "Acme Data — Real-time analytics for event-driven businesses. Secure, multi-cloud ingestion with enterprise-oriented controls."

Jordan will push the attachments and the DocuSign link. Once we have the signed SLA, you're cleared to submit the listings.

Thanks,
Priya Kapoor
Corporate Counsel, Acme Data
[attachment: acme-soc2-summary-redacted.pdf]
[link: https://app.docusign.com/ACME-SLA-8421]"
